title: Deferred feed
description: New activity waits behind a compact unread indicator while the current reading position stays put.
useCase: Accept live updates without pushing the content someone is reading out of view.
interaction: Add a preview update, keep reading, or jump to the newest entry.
reducedMotion: Jump to newest scrolls immediately; unread counts and anchor preservation remain active.
limitations: Four manually triggered local updates; no realtime backend.
look: Light warm-grey page with a white bordered activity card: plus-button header, timeline dots on a thin line, grey timestamps and circled initials.
motion: Adding an update while scrolled down prepends it without shifting visible rows and fades a blue unread pill down 5 px over 180 ms; pressing it smooth-scrolls to the top.
adapt: Scroll anchoring is manual: `add` records the distance from the bottom in `offset` and a `useLayoutEffect` restores it after the prepend, with `overflow-anchor:none` set; `jump` clears `unread`. Replace `labels` with real activity; the pill entrance is the `feed-w2` keyframes.
